svg.title: Languages and toolchain
svg.desc: Languages by share of code in public repositories: Python 49.4%, TypeScript 31.0%, JavaScript 12.4%, C 3.8%, MATLAB 2.3%, C++ 1.1%. Toolchain: PYTHON (language), C / C++ (language), JAVA (language), PYTORCH (deep learning), YOLO (object detection), HUGGING FACE (llms), JETSON (edge ai), CUDA (gpu compute), ARDUINO (microcontroller), ROS 2 (robotics), WEBOTS (robot sim), ARDUPILOT (drones).
